integrity: The fixed quartic is independently checked at the equation level; quotient models, the common j-invariant, and the tangent-space isogeny argument are reconstructed rather than inferred from numerical experiments.
scientific_limitations: The claim is over C and is only an unpolarized isogeny statement. It does not determine the exact isogeny kernel, polarization type, minimal splitting field, Mordell-Weil ranks, or torsion.
title: The fixed genus-three quartic has a cubically split Jacobian
